P01.rationale: No founder portrait appears on this page; the only human imagery is inside a laptop screen showing generic stock photos.

P05.rationale: The client name 'Martina Ammon' is clearly framed and named in the right column with meaningful size, though no actual portrait photo of her is shown.

P07.rationale: A testimonial quote from Martina Ammon appears at the bottom of the right column, but it lacks a structured grid or rating cards typical of social proof apparatuses.

P10.rationale: The giant '01' numeral functions as an oversized decorative typographic element anchoring the right-hand panel.

P11.rationale: Real data visualisations are present: specific monetary savings ('> 200.000 €'), time reduction metrics ('24 Std. → Minuten'), and a count of automated processes ('4').

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text blocks, columns, and data points.

P13.rationale: A subtle paper texture is visible on the background, providing an appropriate atmosphere rather than flat blankness.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used in this layout; therefore, no treatment for overlaid text readability applies here.

P16.rationale: A laptop mockup is shown at the top of the page displaying a grid of images, adding product credibility to the digital context.

N07.rationale: The imagery inside the laptop screen appears generic/stock rather than specific to a real business environment.

N08.rationale: There is no sparse, purposeless dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content in both columns.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without scrim or awkward inset gaps; typography is cleanly separated from imagery.
